_note: Hand-written list of every core.derivation_rule row (W1 fix #55). db/tests/rules.test.ts asserts the database equals this file; core-domain's parity test may read it instead of parsing migration SQL. One entry per (rule_id, source_table); target_tables lists each seeded target. implemented_by = the ticket that owns the deterministic code. Since 0022 (M-C1d, R45 F11) each entry also lists `bindings`: per target table, the SQL predicate over the source row s, the written row n and (UPDATE) its old version o that the guard's derivation branch requires; tests/mc1d.test.ts fails when an entry has none.

bindings.core.stock_movement: n.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND n.ref_id = s.id AND n.outlet_id = s.outlet_id AND n.unit = (SELECT g.base_unit FROM core.ingredient g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.id = n.ingredient_id) AND n.kind = (SELECT CASE l.kind WHEN 'donation' THEN 'donation' ELSE 'surplus_out' END FROM core.cares_listing l WHERE l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.id = s.listing_id) AND -n.qty_milli + coalesce((SELECT sum(-m.qty_milli) FROM core.stock_movement m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND m.ref_id = s.id AND m.kind = n.kind AND m.unit = n.unit AND m.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND m.batch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.batch_id), 0) <= (SELECT ceil(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN ll.item_id IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ll.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND (ll.batch_id IS NULL OR ll.batch_id = n.batch_id) THEN hl.qty_milli * CASE WHEN ll.unit = n.unit THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT cv.f FROM (VALUES ('kg', 'g', 1000::numeric), ('g', 'kg', 0.001), ('l', 'ml', 1000), ('ml', 'l', 0.001)) cv (a, b, f) WHERE cv.a = ll.unit AND cv.b = n.unit) END END ELSE (SELECT sum(hl.qty_milli * rl.qty_milli * (10000 + rl.waste_pct_bp) / (10000.0 * rv.yield_qty_milli)) FROM core.outlet ou JOIN core.recipe_version rv ON rv.tenant_id = ou.tenant_id AND rv.item_id = ll.item_id AND rv.variant_id IS NULL AND rv.valid_from <= ((s.handed_at AT TIME ZONE ou.tz) - ou.business_day_cutoff)::date AND (rv.valid_to IS NULL OR rv.valid_to > ((s.handed_at AT TIME ZONE ou.tz) - ou.business_day_cutoff)::date) JOIN core.recipe_line rl ON rl.tenant_id = rv.tenant_id AND rl.recipe_version_id = rv.id AND rl.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND rl.unit = n.unit WHERE ou.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND ou.id = s.outlet_id) END), 0)) FROM core.cares_handover_line hl JOIN core.cares_listing_line ll ON ll.tenant_id = hl.tenant_id AND ll.id = hl.listing_line_id WHERE hl.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND hl.handover_id = s.id) AND -n.qty_milli + coalesce((SELECT sum(-m.qty_milli) FROM core.stock_movement m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND m.ref_id = s.id AND m.kind = n.kind AND m.unit = n.unit AND m.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id), 0) <= (SELECT ceil(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN ll.item_id IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ll.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id THEN hl.qty_milli * CASE WHEN ll.unit = n.unit THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT cv.f FROM (VALUES ('kg', 'g', 1000::numeric), ('g', 'kg', 0.001), ('l', 'ml', 1000), ('ml', 'l', 0.001)) cv (a, b, f) WHERE cv.a = ll.unit AND cv.b = n.unit) END END ELSE (SELECT sum(hl.qty_milli * rl.qty_milli * (10000 + rl.waste_pct_bp) / (10000.0 * rv.yield_qty_milli)) FROM core.outlet ou JOIN core.recipe_version rv ON rv.tenant_id = ou.tenant_id AND rv.item_id = ll.item_id AND rv.variant_id IS NULL AND rv.valid_from <= ((s.handed_at AT TIME ZONE ou.tz) - ou.business_day_cutoff)::date AND (rv.valid_to IS NULL OR rv.valid_to > ((s.handed_at AT TIME ZONE ou.tz) - ou.business_day_cutoff)::date) JOIN core.recipe_line rl ON rl.tenant_id = rv.tenant_id AND rl.recipe_version_id = rv.id AND rl.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND rl.unit = n.unit WHERE ou.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND ou.id = s.outlet_id) END), 0)) FROM core.cares_handover_line hl JOIN core.cares_listing_line ll ON ll.tenant_id = hl.tenant_id AND ll.id = hl.listing_line_id WHERE hl.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND hl.handover_id = s.id)

n.kind = 'cares_reversal' AND n.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND n.ref_id = s.id AND n.outlet_id = s.outlet_id AND n.qty_milli + coalesce((SELECT sum(r.qty_milli) FROM core.stock_movement r WHERE r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND r.ref_id = s.id AND r.kind = 'cares_reversal' AND r.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND r.batch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.batch_id AND r.unit = n.unit), 0) <= coalesce((SELECT sum(-c.qty_milli) FROM core.stock_movement c WHERE c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.ref_type = 'core.cares_handover' AND c.ref_id = s.id AND c.kind IN ('donation', 'surplus_out') AND c.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND c.batch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.batch_id AND c.unit = n.unit), 0)

n.kind = 'surplus_in' AND n.ref_type = 'core.cares_claim' AND n.ref_id = s.id AND n.outlet_id = s.outlet_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.cares_claim_line cl WHERE cl.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cl.claim_id = s.id AND cl.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND cl.unit = n.unit AND cl.received_qty_milli = n.qty_milli AND (n.batch_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.batch b WHERE b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND b.id = n.batch_id AND b.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND b.expires_on IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cl.expires_on))) AND n.qty_milli + coalesce((SELECT sum(m.qty_milli) FROM core.stock_movement m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.ref_type = 'core.cares_claim' AND m.ref_id = s.id AND m.kind = 'surplus_in' AND m.unit = n.unit AND m.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id), 0) <= (SELECT coalesce(sum(cl.received_qty_milli), 0) FROM core.cares_claim_line cl WHERE cl.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cl.claim_id = s.id AND cl.ingredient_id = n.ingredient_id AND cl.unit = n.unit)
